verdict.rationale: Muse is designed around a chat interface where users talk to it in natural language to manage goals, tasks, and tool-building ('talk to it about these tasks in chat', side chats for topic-specific NL interaction). This is corroborated by first-party docs describing conversational control as the primary interface. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of broad natural-language command coverage beyond goals/chat, and detail on command reliability at scale (comm-1 notes control-plane timeouts under stress).
